# Contract 3 conformance fixture

This directory is the theme-contract-3 theme the tooling's own test suite
runs against (`THEME_ROOT`). It is a complete theme package carrying the
`@rathnasgala2/schemas` 3.0.0 `default-3.0.json` Default values, so the
tooling can be verified without a theme repository checkout. It is not a
published theme.
